title: Northwind Traders opens new distribution centre in Seattle
text:
Northwind Traders, the speciality food wholesaler, has opened a new distribution centre in Seattle to serve restaurants across the Pacific Northwest.

The centre replaces two older warehouses and employs 85 people. Northwind said the site uses conveyor sorting but no robotics for now.

Northwind Traders has no connection to the European robot maker of a similar name.
